messages:
anne: FYI KMS anomaly — we see a big spike in decrypt calls against the partner-webhook-prod key. suspected leaked partner service account keys. need immediate containment + rotation. runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/kms-incident
sec-bot: Alert: kms-decrypt-rate-spike triggered for key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partner/cryptoKeys/webhook-key
jon: On it. I'll audit recent callers and throttle partner project. plan to revoke partner SA keys first, then rewrap ciphertexts. pinging infra crew.
maria: I can deploy a temporary deny policy on Vault transit to block automatic unwraps. which systems are reading the wrapped blobs?
kevin: ingestion-worker and partner-sync are the main ones. ingestion-worker can fallback to cached tokens for ~30m, partner-sync needs a pause.
anne: Quick plan: 1) add IAM deny for partner SA 2) revoke SA keys 3) issue new partner-scoped ephemeral creds 4) create new KMS key version + rewrap ciphertext 5) run Vault rewrap for affected blobs 6) update audit/telemetry to detect replays. assignments below.
jon: Assigning myself to revoke SA keys + collect decrypt callers. I'll run this script to nuke keys and then list recent callers. posting snippet.
jon: ```bash
for KEY in $(gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=partner@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format='value(name)'); do
  gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete $KEY --iam-account=partner@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com --quiet
done
```
maria: I'll write a deny policy to Vault and apply to the transit mount so no automated unwraps occur while we rewrap. command I plan: `vault policy write deny-unwrap - <<EOF ... EOF`
kevin: I'll toggle ingestion-worker to read-from-cache mode and pause the partner-sync queue. ping me when rewraps finished so I can resume.
anne: Rotation decision: prefer create a new KMS key version and rewrap rather than trying to rotate every ciphertext in-place. need backups of current ciphertexts before rewrap. jon/maria coordinate snapshot.
jon: Creating new key version now. after key version is ready I'll run a dry-run rewrap on staging, then run bulk rewrap script against production blobs. example: `gcloud kms keys versions create --key=webhook-key --location=global --keyring=partner --purpose=encryption` and then `python tools/kms_rewrap.py --src-version=old --dst-version=new --dry-run`
maria: Reminder: enable verbose IAM/KMS audit logging for the next 2 hours and don't silence alerts during the rewrap. I'll flip audit sinks and add a short retention export.
sec-bot: Incident-Tracker: created incident INF-2026-047; triage leads: anne, jon; containment target: 30m
anne: Status update: partner SA keys revoked (jon), Vault deny policy applied (maria), ingestion-worker flipped to cache mode (kevin). jon please post the list of ciphertext blobs you'll rewrap and the dry-run results.
jon: Posting list in a sec — started rewrap dry-run on staging, no failures so far (small sample). will produce CSV of affected blob ids when dry-run completes.
kevin: I'll prepare rollback/mitigation in case any blobs fail (fallback to original wrapped blob store + replay protection).
anne: Post-incident actions: anne+sec will own postmortem. need to cover: how SA keys leaked, why replays weren't rate-limited earlier, add a unit test to detect sudden decrypt bursts, and tighten partner onboarding checklist.
maria: Copy. capturing audit logs now and exporting to gs://redwood-incident-audits/INF-2026-047 for analysis.
sre-oncall: Noted — updating oncall timeline and will hold capacity for any followups during rewrap window.
anne: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. keep this thread updated with timestamps, PR links, and export locations. final containment ETA ~ 45m unless rewrap has issues.
